title: oxytropis lapponica
intro: Oxytropis lapponica, commonly known as Arctic milkvetch, is a perennial legume plant native to subarctic and alpine regions. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Oxytropis lapponica include its ability to stimulate blood circulation, reduce pain, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
